meta.title: 烂业绩数据也能讲出亮点｜六步法
meta.title_en: How to Find Highlights in Terrible Performance Data

scenes.context: 讲者说明动机：老板开大会面对烂数据，不能说「我们要完蛋了」。
sentences: 怎么让糟糕的业绩数据讲出让团队觉得有亮点？
How do you present terrible performance data in a way that feels full of highlights?
糟糕的业绩：terrible performance
面对糟糕透顶的数据，你总不能说我们要完蛋了吧。
Facing disastrous numbers, you can't just say we're doomed.
糟糕透顶：disastrous / doom
每一步都是在累进地增加概率。
Each step progressively raises your odds of success.
累进增加：progressively raise
paraphrase: 把坏消息讲成亮点 → 换角度
Frame bad news by shifting your angle.
增加概率 → 层层加码
Each step stacks the deck in your favor.
scenes.speak: How do you present terrible performance data in a way that feels full of highlights? Facing disastrous numbers, you can't just say we're doomed. Each step progressively raises your odds of success.

scenes.title_cn: 前四步：环比同比与拆解
scenes.title_en: First four steps: month-over-month, year-over-year, and breakdowns
scenes.context: 讲者给出环比、同比、拆业务线、拆财务角度四步。
sentences: 第一看环比数据，这个月跟上个月比。
First, look at month-over-month numbers — this month versus last month.
环比：month-over-month
环比没涨就看同比，今年跟去年比，剔除季节因素。
If it's flat month-over-month, compare year-over-year to remove seasonal effects.
同比：year-over-year
拆得越细，越可能找出上升的业务亮点。
The finer the breakdown, the more likely you'll spot an uptrend.
拆得越细：the finer the breakdown
paraphrase: Compare this month against last month.
今年比去年 → 同比（剔除季节）
Compare against last year to rule out seasonal factors.
scenes.speak: First, look at month-over-month numbers — this month versus last month. If it's flat, compare year-over-year to remove seasonal effects. The finer the breakdown, the more likely you'll spot an uptrend.

scenes.title_cn: 最后两步：造指标与定口径
scenes.title_en: Last two steps: invent a metric and define your scope
scenes.context: 讲者给出创造指标与定义「异向客户」两个兜底办法。
sentences: 还是没亮点，就创造一个指标。
Still no highlight? Then invent a metric.
创造指标：invent a metric
可以用销售额除以团队人数，叫人均产能。
Divide sales by headcount to get productivity per person.
人均产能：productivity per person
异向客户数量，你可以自己定义。
The number of interested customers — you can define it yourself.
自己定义：define it yourself
paraphrase: 造一个新指标 → 换叙事口径
Create a fresh metric to change the story.
自己定义口径 → 掌握解释权
Set your own definitions to control the narrative.
scenes.speak: Still no highlight? Then invent a metric. Divide sales by headcount to get productivity per person. The number of interested customers — you can define it yourself.

practice: We compare year-over-year to rule out seasonal effects.
We created a new metric to tell a better story.
Productivity per person improved after the reorg.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：This month than last month up.
✓ 地道说法：Sales were up month-over-month.
month-over-month / year-over-year 是固定商业表达。
✓ 地道说法：Rule out seasonal effects.
rule out 比 remove 更自然。
✓ 地道说法：Spot an uptrend / find a highlight.
uptrend 是商业语境更专业的词。
用 disastrous 强化语气更生动。
shifts: 把烂数据当作「认错的证据」
把烂数据当作「找亮点的素材」
把指标当作「固定不变的口径」
把指标当作「可选择的叙事视角」
把「没亮点」当作汇报的终点
把「没亮点」当作继续拆解/换口径的起点
footer_notes: ASR 专有名词已按语境校正（如「异向客户」按上下文保留为讲者自定义词「异向客户」）。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
